title: Material & cost estimation
sentences: An estimate combines geometry with practical constraints.
Find the area or volume that needs material, remove openings, and include the required number of coats.
Divide by coverage to find material quantity.
When material is sold in whole containers or packs, round up the number of packages, then calculate the purchase cost.
Paint comes in 4 L cans at 900 pesos each.
Then 8.4 ÷ 4 = 2.1 cans, so buy 3 whole cans.
spoken: An estimate combines geometry with practical constraints.
Find the area or volume that needs material, remove openings, and include the required number of coats.
Divide by coverage to find material quantity.
When material is sold in whole containers or packs, round up the number of packages, then calculate the purchase cost.
Paint 42 square meters with two coats.
Coverage is 10 square meters divided by liters.
Paint comes in 4 liters cans at 900 pesos each.
42 times 2 equals 84 square meters of coating.
Then 8.4 divided by 4 equals 2.1 cans, so buy 3 whole cans.
3 times 900 equals 2,700 pesos at this illustrative price.
